title: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
abstract: arXiv:2611.19108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another. LLM judges and an expert mathematician prefer

translated_title: 通过编码定理之间的承继关系来引导AI智能体生成数学猜想
translated_abstract: 近来，大语言模型（LLMs）在数学研究领域频频登上头条，并取得了实质性进展。其中许多工作聚焦于证明已有的公开猜想。然而，“决定该证明什么”则更为困难且研究较少，原因在于缺乏明确的标准来判定什么样的猜想值得研究。我们提出了一种猜想生成方法，该方法基于这样一个观察：数学定理之间是层层递进、相互构建的——新定理可以修改早期定理的设定或假设、强化其结论，或扩展其适用范围。我们将这些关系编码在一种新型图结构——定理演化图中，并将其实现为LLM智能体的一种在线搜索方法。智能体通过两个步骤构建TEG：(1) 从种子论文出发，通过向前和向后追踪引用，从找到的论文中识别相关定理；(2) 对这些定理进行比较，记录一个定理如何建立在另一个定理之上。LLM评审和一位专家数学家都更倾向于……（摘要在此处似乎被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新型图结构——定理演化图（TEG），通过编码定理之间相互承继与演进的关系，引导LLM智能体生成值得研究的数学猜想。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), a novel graph structure that encodes how theorems build on one another, guiding LLM agents to generate mathematical conjectures worth pursuing.
